measures.name: total_revenue
measures.expr: SUM(TRY_CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(10,2)) * TRY_CAST(unit_price AS DECIMAL(10,2)))

config.comment: Delivered-order sales metrics from the Gold layer (delivered orders only)
Product-level delivered sales aggregation from the Gold layer

dimensions.name: lifecycle_stage
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN order_status = 'Delivered' THEN 'Delivered'
  WHEN order_status = 'Cancelled' THEN 'Cancelled'
  WHEN order_status IN ('Shipped', 'Processing') THEN 'Pending (Shipped/Processing)'
  ELSE 'Returned'
END

measures.name: count
measures.comment: Represents the total number of rows in the dataset. Use this measure to count all

measures.name: pending_orders
measures.comment: Orders still in flight (Shipped or Processing)

config.source:
SELECT product_name,
       SUM(TRY_CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(10,2)) * TRY_CAST(unit_price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS product_revenue
FROM ecommerce_sdp.default.gold_delivered_orders
GROUP BY product_name
ORDER BY product_revenue ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT product_name,
       SUM(TRY_CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(10,2)) * TRY_CAST(unit_price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS product_revenue
FROM ecommerce_sdp.default.gold_delivered_orders
GROUP BY product_name
ORDER BY product_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10
